summary: This is a Form 6-K furnished by Banco Santander (Brasil) S.A., a foreign private issuer, reporting minutes of a Board of Directors meeting held on July 10, 2026. The sole resolution was the approval of a declaration and payment of Interest on Company's Equity (ICEs) in the gross amount of R$ 2,000,000,000.00 (approximately R$ 0.2546 per common share, R$ 0.2801 per preferred share, R$ 0.5347 per Unit) payable on August 6, 2026, to shareholders of record July 21, 2026. The ICEs will be considered part of mandatory dividends for 2026. No M&A, restructuring, or other special situation is involved; this is a routine capital return by a foreign issuer in compliance with Brazilian corporate law. Not a special situation.
